scene nightsky
There was a time long ago where I practically lived at the dorms.
lines.zh: 很久以前，有那么一阵子我几乎就住在宿舍里。

lines.en: Where every night there was {i}someone{/i} to help me take my mind off {i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: 那时候每一夜都{i}有人{/i}帮我把心思从{i}某件事{/i}上挪开。

lines.en: Just, when this all began, there wasn’t much to take my mind off in the first place. So, more often than not, I found myself searching for anything of...{i}interest.{/i}
lines.zh: 只是，在这一切刚开始的时候，本来也没什么需要我挪开心思的事。所以大多数时候，我发现自己在找任何……{i}有趣{/i}的东西。

lines.en: Often, that interest was sexual in nature. And I guess that much hasn’t {i}entirely{/i} changed.
lines.zh: 那种兴趣往往是性方面的。我想这一点到现在也没{i}怎么{/i}变。

lines.en: But there was something else back then. Curiosity, I guess you could call it.
lines.zh: 但那时候还有别的东西。好奇心吧，也许可以这么叫。

lines.en: And most of that bled from a girl so consistently dismissive and {i}weird{/i} that I found myself drawn to her almost immediately.
lines.zh: 而那大部分都源自一个女孩——她一贯地冷淡又{i}古怪{/i}，以至于我几乎立刻就被吸引了过去。

lines.en: But perhaps that’s just the way it’s {i}always{/i} been.
lines.zh: 但也许{i}一直{/i}就是这样。

lines.en: No, not “perhaps.” That {i}is{/i} the way it’s always been. Since before I was me. Since before I wasn’t.
lines.zh: 不，不是“也许”。一直{i}就是{/i}这样。早在我还是我之前。早在我还不是我之前。

lines.en: She was always the constant.
lines.zh: 她一直是那个恒量。

lines.en: She was always {i}the one.{/i}
lines.zh: 她一直是{i}那一个人{/i}。

lines.en: scene black
Until she wasn’t.
lines.zh: 直到她不再是。

scene mayaboxwaitwhat1
{b}NOW SHE’S FOLDED UP IN A BLANKET OF FLESH — A FACADE TO FUCK AND NOTHING MORE. THE GUM STUCK TO THE BOTTOM OF THIS ETERNAL SHOE.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}现在她被裹进了一层血肉的毯子里——一具用来操的门面，仅此而已。粘在这只永恒之鞋鞋底的口香糖。{/b}

lines.en: {b}I WANT TO TEAR HER OPEN AND PULL THE OLD ONE OUT. WHO DOES SHE THINK SHE IS MASQUERADING IN CLOTHES THAT DON’T FIT? TOUCHING HER THINGS?{/b}
lines.zh: {b}我想把她撕开，把原来那个拖出来。她算什么东西，穿着不合身的衣服招摇过市？还碰她的东西？{/b}

lines.en: {b}I HOPE THERE’S A WISH INSIDE OF THAT BOX FOR SHE WILL NEED ONE TO BREATHE LIFE BACK INTO HER BODY WHEN I AM FINISHED WITH-{/b}
lines.zh: {b}我希望那只盒子里装着一个愿望，因为等我对她下手完，她会需要一个愿望，才能把生命重新吹回她的身体里——{/b}

lines.en: : {b}DON’T KILL ME AGAIN! PLEASE!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}别再杀我了！求你了！{/b}

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat2
: Hi?
: ...Maya?
lines.zh: : ……Maya？

lines.en: : {i}Which{/i} Maya?
lines.zh: : {i}哪个{/i} Maya？

lines.en: : Old Maya? Or...{i}new{/i} Maya?
lines.zh: : 旧 Maya？还是……{i}新{/i} Maya？

lines.en: : Maya Maya. The only Maya there is.
lines.zh: : Maya 就是 Maya。唯一的那个 Maya。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat3
: But I {i}guess{/i} I’m “new” Maya based on the way you have separated us into different tiers of {i}Mayability{/i} now despite us being the same exact entity on a conceptual level.
lines.zh: : 不过按你现在的分法，把我们按{i}"Maya 度"{/i}分成不同等级，那我{i}大概{/i}算是"新"Maya 吧，尽管我们在概念层面上是同一个存在。

lines.en: Of course it was too good to be true. Of course the only “constant” now is that feeling there should be something by my side when there isn’t.
lines.zh: 当然了，好得不像真的。当然了，现在唯一的"恒量"就是那种——本该有东西在我身边，却没有的感觉。

lines.en: But {i}why?{/i}
lines.zh: 可是{i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Why{/i} is she holding that?
lines.zh: {i}为什么{/i}她抱着那个东西？

lines.en: : What...are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你……在干什么？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat4
: What are {i}you{/i} doing? You’ve been standing there useless for five minutes now while a small girl is being crushed by the weight of this box.
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？{i}你{/i}都站在那儿当废物站了五分钟了，一个小女孩正被这个盒子压得喘不过气。

lines.en: : Isn’t this the part where you offer to help me carry it?
lines.zh: : 这难道不是你该主动提出帮我搬的时候吗？

lines.en: : {i}Why...{/i}are you carrying it?
lines.zh: : {i}为什么{/i}……你在搬这个？

lines.en: : Why are {i}you{/i} getting so emotional over a box? It’s just a box.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}为什么对一个盒子这么上心？它就是个盒子而已。

lines.en: : Because {i}this{/i} has happened before. This is something {i}she{/i} would make me do.
lines.zh: : 因为{i}这种事{/i}以前发生过。这是{i}她{/i}会让我做的事。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat5
: Millions and billions and trillions of years or whatever and {i}still{/i} lazy. I’m so proud of me.
lines.zh: : 几百万、几十亿、几万亿年还是什么的，{i}还是{/i}这么懒。我真为自己骄傲。

lines.en: : Maya...what’s in that? What are you...transporting?
lines.zh: : Maya……那里面是什么？你在……运什么？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat4
: Well, what did {i}your{/i} me make you transport? Maybe it’s the same thing.
lines.zh: : 那{i}你的{/i}那个我让你运过什么？也许是同样的东西。

lines.en: : I don’t know. She never let me open the box.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。她从来不让我打开盒子。

lines.en: : Do you...{i}want{/i} to open the box?
lines.zh: : 你……{i}想{/i}打开盒子吗？

lines.en: : Can I?...
lines.zh: : 我可以吗？……

lines.en: : Sure. Go for it.
lines.zh: : 当然。尽管试。

lines.en: I reach forward and-
lines.zh: 我伸手向前，然后——

lines.en: menu:
Don’t open the box
lines.zh: 别打开盒子

lines.en: And I still...can’t.
lines.zh: 而我依然……做不到。

lines.en: : What’s the matter?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : I...can’t do it.
lines.zh: : 我……做不到。

lines.en: : I just...can’t bring myself to open it.
lines.zh: : 我就是……下不了手打开它。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat6
: I fucking knew it! This thing {i}is{/i} cursed!
lines.zh: : 我他妈就知道！这玩意儿{i}被诅咒了{/i}！

lines.en: : I...what? I don’t understand. You-
lines.zh: : 我……什么？我不明白。你——

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat7
: I can’t open it either! I have no idea what’s inside!
lines.zh: : 我也打不开！我根本不知道里面是什么！

lines.en: : Then why are you-
lines.zh: : 那你为什么——

lines.en: : Because of fucking Ami!
lines.zh: : 因为fucking Ami！

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat8
: She keeps leaving these fucking boxes in there and refuses to move them herself.
lines.zh: : 她不停把那些该死的盒子留在里面，自己却死也不肯搬。

lines.en: : So I’ve just been taking them every time she shows up and throwing them in the trash.
lines.zh: : 所以每次她一出现，我就把它们拿走，扔进垃圾桶。

lines.en: : The...trash?! No! Those aren’t supposed to go in there! They need to go to the school!
lines.zh: : 垃圾……桶？！不行！那些不该扔那儿！它们得送到学校去！

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat9
: The school? Why?
lines.zh: : 学校？为什么？

lines.en: : That’s just...
lines.zh: : 那只是……

lines.en: : That’s where we always took them in the past. I don’t...really {i}know{/i} why.
lines.zh: : 那是我们以前一直送过去的地方。我……其实也不{i}知道{/i}为什么。

lines.en: : So you...routinely fell into line and carried these things all the way to the school just because “old” me told you? No questions asked?
lines.zh: : 所以你……就乖乖听话，一路把这些东西扛到学校去，只因为"旧"的我这么说了？一句也不问？

lines.en: : There were questions asked. Just...seldom answered.
lines.zh: : 问过。只是……很少得到回答。

lines.en: : Damn. You are {i}whipped.{/i}
lines.zh: : 天哪。你{i}被吃得死死的{/i}。

lines.en: : {i}Were{/i} whipped. I’m a free man now. Sad, yes. But free.
lines.zh: : {i}曾经{/i}被吃得死死的。我现在是自由身了。可悲，没错。但自由。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat10
: {i}For now.{/i} But each hint you give me about your “ideal” version of me just brings me one step closer to emulating her.
lines.zh: : {i}暂时是{/i}。可你每给我一点关于你"理想版本"的我的提示，就让我离模仿她更近一步。

lines.en: : Which means that {i}I’ll{/i} be cracking the whip before you even know it, Sensei. Now please, make yourself useful and take this off of my hands.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，在你反应过来之前，{i}我{/i}就会开始挥鞭子了，Sensei。所以现在，麻烦你有点用，把这个从我手上接过去。

lines.en: : I’m {i}waiting.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我在{i}等{/i}。

lines.en: scene black
: {i}Hah...{/i}fine. But we’re taking it to the school.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}好吧。但我们得把它送去学校。

lines.en: : Fine by me. You’re the one doing all of the heavy lifting. Literally. {i}And{/i} I’m still dressed for the part.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。反正出力气的字面意义上是你。{i}而且{/i}我这身打扮也挺应景的。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat11
: Why {i}are{/i} you still wearing your uniform anyway?
lines.zh: : 话说你怎么{i}还{/i}穿着制服？

lines.en: : I wanted to be ready in case we randomly crossed paths. I didn’t want to risk dressing like an adult and having you suddenly not like me anymore.
lines.zh: : 我想万一我们偶然撞见，我得随时准备好。我不想冒险穿得像个成年人，结果你突然就不喜欢我了。

lines.en: : I don’t think adults wear bells around their neck.
lines.zh: : 我觉得成年人不会在脖子上挂铃铛。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat12
: They do when their pervert boyfriends buy them as gifts. Did I ever say thank you for that, by the way?
lines.zh: : 如果铃铛是她们的变态男朋友买来送的，那就会。话说回来，我有为那个道过谢吗？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t remember even if you had.
lines.zh: : 就算你谢过我也不记得了。

lines.en: : Let’s just say I did then. And let’s {i}also{/i} say that I still have a few {i}other{/i} things you bought me for the same creepy purposes.
lines.zh: : 那就当我谢过吧。{i}另外{/i}，你为了同样猥琐的目的买给我的{i}其他{/i}几样东西，我也还留着。

lines.en: : You have what now?
lines.zh: : 你还有什么？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat13
: Oooooh? Did {i}your{/i} Maya keep her sexy cosplay closet a secret? But you spent so much money on it.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦？难道{i}你的{/i} Maya 把她的性感角色扮演衣柜藏起来了？可你在上面花了那么多钱呢。

lines.en: : You...you have a secret sexy cosplay closet?
lines.zh: : 你……你有个秘密的性感角色扮演衣柜？

lines.en: : You’re more than welcome to raid it with me once you accept me for who I am and stop trying to turn me into your comfortably numb dream-girl thing.
lines.zh: : 等你接受我本来的样子、不再试图把我变成你那个舒适麻木的梦幻女孩，我很欢迎你跟我一起去翻。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat14
: {i}Fucking Maya...{/i}of course she’d hide that from me. There’d be no holding me back at all if I ever found out.
lines.zh: : {i}Fucking Maya{/i}……她当然会瞒着我。要是我早发现了，就再也没什么能拦得住我了。

lines.en: : Sounds like you and I would have been reacquainted much sooner if you did. So I guess I’ll go ahead and be mad at her too.
lines.zh: : 听上去，你要是真发现了，我们早就重修旧好了。那我也就一起生她的气好了。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat15
: Can I...ask you something?
lines.zh: : 我能……问你一件事吗？

lines.en: : I already told you. I don’t know what’s in the box.
lines.zh: : 我说过了。我不知道盒子里是什么。

lines.en: : Not that. Just...did giving up on me ever cross your mind this past year? Did you {i}not{/i} lose hope in me at any point?
lines.zh: : 不是那个。只是……过去这一年里，你有没有想过要放弃我？{i}有没有{/i}在哪个瞬间对我失去过希望？

lines.en: : Of course not. {i}Losing{/i} hope would imply that I ever had any hope in you to begin with. And that’s just dumb.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。{i}失去{/i}希望的前提是我一开始对你抱有希望。那也太蠢了。

lines.en: : Seriously, though...did you ever think about just...trying to find someone else?
lines.zh: : 说真的……你有没有想过……去找别人？

lines.en: : Romantically? No. I want you, so I am going to {i}have{/i} you because I am cute and that entitles me to getting whatever it is I want.
lines.zh: : 恋爱意义上的？没有。我想要你，所以我要{i}得到{/i}你，因为我很可爱，而这就让我有权得到我想要的任何东西。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat16
: I {i}did{/i} have a sex dream about Otoha once, though. So you can go ahead and call that some sort of {i}forbidden desire{/i} if that turns you on or something.
lines.zh: : 不过我{i}有一次{/i}做了个关于 Otoha 的春梦。要是那样能让你兴奋还是什么的，你尽管把这当成某种{i}禁忌的欲望{/i}好了。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I, too, have had sex dreams about Otoha.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我也做过关于 Otoha 的春梦。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat17
: You {i}bastard.{/i} I am {i}right{/i} here. Have you no consideration whatsoever for my feelings?
lines.zh: : 你这个{i}混蛋{/i}。我{i}就{/i}在这儿。你就一点都不顾及我的感受吗？

lines.en: : I can’t tell if you’re being serious or not.
lines.zh: : 我分不清你是认真的还是在开玩笑。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat18
: There’s a little bit of truth in every single lie, you know?  I won’t let myself get beat up over it, though.
lines.zh: : 每个谎言里都有一点点真话，你知道吗？不过我不会为这个让自己挨揍。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat19
: I know I’ve got my work cut out for me if I’m going to find myself on the same level as all of the girls you’re currently sleeping with who {i}haven’t{/i} disappeared at some point.
lines.zh: : 我知道，要爬到和那些你现在正在睡、又{i}从没{/i}在某个时点消失过的女孩同一水平线上，我还有得忙。

lines.en: : But I’ll get there. I’ll get there and you’ll see why you chose {i}me{/i} as “the one” long before you even {i}met{/i} any of those girls.
lines.zh: : 但我会的。我会做到，然后你就会明白，早在{i}遇见{/i}她们任何一个之前，你为什么选了{i}我{/i}当"那一个人"。

lines.en: : Then things will be good again. And we can go back to normal. Or {i}change{/i} what’s normal if that’s really what you want.
lines.zh: : 然后一切就会重新好起来。我们就能回到正轨。或者，如果你真想的话，把"正轨"{i}换一个样子{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s like falling in love all over. I should feel {i}lucky{/i} I get to experience that again.
lines.zh: : 就像重新坠入爱河。我应该觉得{i}庆幸{/i}，还能再体验一次。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat20
: But instead, I’m just sad.
lines.zh: : 可我有的只是难过。

lines.en: : I miss you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我想你，Sensei。

lines.en: : Maya-
lines.zh: : Maya——

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat21
: Come on! Let’s get that box to school for whatever reason we’re supposed to take it there!
lines.zh: : 走吧！不管我们为什么要把那盒子送去学校，赶紧送过去！

lines.en: scene black
: {i}Hah...{/i}yeah.
: {i}I’m right behind you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我就跟在你后面。{/i}

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat22
: Wow. This place is actually kind of creepy at night.
lines.zh: : 哇。这地方晚上还真有点瘆人。

lines.en: : You should see it when it’s all red and crawling with weird, paranormal entities.
lines.zh: : 你该看看它整个变成红色、爬满奇怪的灵异实体的时候。

lines.en: : Do I have to? That sounds like it sucks.
lines.zh: : 非看不可吗？听起来糟透了。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say you {i}have{/i} to. Just know that if you do, it’s actually a good thing because it means you can start learning more about how the world works.
lines.zh: : 我不会说{i}非看不可{/i}。只是你要真看到了，其实那是好事，因为那意味着你可以开始多了解这个世界是怎么运转的。

lines.en: : Or...{i}doesn’t{/i} work. It’s complicated.
lines.zh: : 或者……是怎么{i}不{/i}运转的。挺复杂的。

lines.en: : More...time stuff...right? Things that {i}your{/i} me was interested in?
lines.zh: : 又是……时间那一类的事……对吧？{i}你的{/i}那个我感兴趣的东西？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat23
: I’m not really sure how much of it was interest and...how much was just a result of her being forced to endure it for so long.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定其中有多少是兴趣，又有多少只是她被迫忍耐了太久的结果。

lines.en: : Well, for what it’s worth, I {i}am{/i} interested in that stuff. Sci-fi. Quantum physics. But it’s all more fiction-focused than anything involving actual science.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，我对那些东西{i}是{/i}感兴趣的。科幻。量子物理。只是比起真正的科学，我更偏向虚构那一边。

lines.en: : But I blame you for that. You and Billy Pilgrim.
lines.zh: : 但这都得怪你。你，还有 Billy Pilgrim。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat24
: Me?
: Mhm. You and the high school curriculum you forced onto a child because you were so starved for an actual intellectual conversation after your sex-mom died.
lines.zh: : 嗯。还有你硬塞给一个小孩子的那套高中课程，因为你的性妈妈死后，你饿得要命，就想找人好好聊点有智识的东西。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat25
: Well, that sentence hit me like a truck.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这句话像卡车一样撞了我一下。

lines.en: : There’s another joke to be made here, but I think that one might be pushing it a bit.
lines.zh: : 这里还能再开一个玩笑，不过我觉得那个可能有点过了。

lines.en: : I’d appreciate it if you wouldn’t call her a “sex-mom” in the future. She was...a lot more than that, Maya.
lines.zh: : 希望你以后别再叫她"性妈妈"了。她……远远不止是那样，Maya。

lines.en: : Right. Just like how {i}you{/i} are more to me than what you tell yourself you are.
lines.zh: : 说得对。就像{i}你{/i}对我来说，也远远不止是你告诉自己的那个样子。

lines.en: : So please don’t die, for I have seen what I would turn into and it is not pretty. If nothing else, try living for that.
lines.zh: : 所以请别死。因为我已经见过我会变成什么样子，那可不好看。别的不说，就算为了这个，也试着活下去吧。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat26
: I’m gonna go stash this in the room beside you. I’m pretty sure...{i}that{/i} was the one we always put them in.
lines.zh: : 我去把它藏到你旁边那间教室里。我挺确定……以前我们一直放在{i}那一间{/i}。

lines.en: : Okay...I’ll be here.
lines.zh: : 好……我在这儿等你。

lines.en: scene black
I slide open the door to an empty classroom and drop the box off in the corner, trying (and failing) once more to open it.
lines.zh: 我拉开一间空教室的门，把盒子搁在角落，再一次试着（并且失败地）打开它。

lines.en: I want to stay here.
lines.zh: 我想留在这儿。

lines.en: Not {i}just{/i} so I don’t have to go back out into the hall and face the fact that even {i}this{/i} version of her — who smiles and {i}speaks{/i} to me — is one I want to enrapture...
lines.zh: 不{i}只是{/i}为了不必走回走廊、去面对这样一个事实——即便是{i}这个版本{/i}的她，这个会笑、会跟我{i}说话{/i}的她，也是我想要占有的……

lines.en: But to figure out {i}what{/i} this is. And how {i}Ami{/i} is somehow involved now.
lines.zh: 更是为了弄清楚这是{i}什么{/i}。以及 {i}Ami{/i} 怎么会也卷进来了。

lines.en: Why would {i}she{/i} ask Maya to take this here? Why can’t {i}Maya{/i} open it either?
lines.zh: {i}她{/i}为什么要让 Maya 把这个带到这里？为什么 {i}Maya{/i} 也打不开？

lines.en: Was that...always how it worked?
lines.zh: 难道……一直都是这样的吗？

lines.en: Was that just something else she hid from me?
lines.zh: 难道那也是她瞒着我的另一件事？

lines.en: If I stay here, maybe I can see what happens.
lines.zh: 如果我留在这儿，也许我能看见接下来会发生什么。

lines.en: Maybe I can see who comes to take this to wherever it’s meant to be- because it most assuredly isn’t the first. And it most assuredly won’t be the last.
lines.zh: 也许我能看见谁来把它带去它该去的地方——因为它绝对不是第一个，也绝对不会是最后一个。

lines.en: If I never leave, though...
lines.zh: 可要是我永远不离开……

lines.en: I’ll never see that smile again.
lines.zh: 我就再也见不到那个笑容了。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat27
And I’ll also never figure out what’s inside of the apparent sex closet — which is now, unfortunately, a top priority for me.
lines.zh: 而且我也永远搞不清那个所谓的性爱衣柜里有什么——这很不幸，现在已经成了我的头等大事。

lines.en: Right after I figure out why Maya dragged me back into my old classroom.
lines.zh: 就排在搞清楚 Maya 为什么把我拖回我以前那间教室之后。

lines.en: : Been a while, hasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 好久没回来了吧？

lines.en: : And for good reason. I was never fit to be a high school teacher.
lines.zh: : 而且不无道理。我从来就不适合当高中老师。

lines.en: : You sure weren’t, Sensei. And anyone who’d pay you to hang out with teenage girls clearly isn’t fit to serve this community either.
lines.zh: : 你确实不适合，Sensei。再说，任何花钱雇你去陪少女厮混的人，显然也不配为这个社区服务。

lines.en: : That was the part where most other people try to say something uplifting about how my methods are “unusual” but how I’ve wound up helping in the long run.
lines.zh: : 这种时候，大多数人都会试图说点激励的话，比如我的方法"不同寻常"，但从长远看我还是帮上了忙之类的。

lines.en: : Then I guess I don’t need to say anything because I’m living proof of that.
lines.zh: : 那我看我就什么也不用说了，因为我就是活生生的证据。

lines.en: : Everything I am is because of you. And you have the rare opportunity right now to continue cultivating me. To make me something even {i}bigger.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我之所以是我，全都是因为你。而现在你有一个难得的机会，可以继续栽培我。把我塑造成更{i}了不起{/i}的东西。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat28
: So come — over here. To my desk.
lines.zh: : 所以过来吧——到这边来。到我的课桌前。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat29
: Teach me more about who I’ll be next. About what you {i}want{/i} the result of the “Maya Raising Project” to be.
lines.zh: : 再多教教我，我接下来会成为谁。你{i}想{/i}要"Maya 养成计划"的最终成果是什么样的。

lines.en: : I want you to be whatever makes you happy.
lines.zh: : 我想让你成为任何让你开心的样子。

lines.en: : Hahah. Cute. But really — what do you {i}really{/i} want?
lines.zh: : 哈哈。真可爱。不过说真的——你{i}到底{/i}想要什么？

lines.en: : An actor? Want me to perfectly mimic your last true love? Recite her lines like they’re my own? Even if they {i}are{/i} my own. Which they are. Because again, same person.
lines.zh: : 演员？要我完美复刻你上一位真爱？把她的台词像自己的一样念出来？反正它们{i}本来就是{/i}我的。因为再说一遍，同一个人。

lines.en: : Or maybe someone even smarter than you? Someone like {i}her.{/i} The {i}first{/i} girl you lost.
lines.zh: : 或者，也许是个比你更聪明的人？像{i}她{/i}那样的人。你失去的{i}第一个{/i}女孩。

lines.en: : Just, whatever you do, don’t ask me to be an idol because I fucking {i}hate{/i} Niki and I fucking {i}hate{/i} her annoying bitch of a sister.
lines.zh: : 只是，不管你要我做什么，别叫我当偶像，因为我他妈的{i}讨厌{/i} Niki，也他妈的{i}讨厌{/i}她那个烦人的婊子妹妹。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I kind of want to see idol Maya now. Is there something like that in the sex closet?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我现在倒有点想看偶像版 Maya 了。性爱衣柜里有那种东西吗？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat30
: There {i}sure{/i} is. It just brings back bad memories.
lines.zh: : {i}当然{/i}有。只是会勾起不好的回忆。

lines.en: : Was I too rough on you while you were wearing it?
lines.zh: : 是你穿着它的时候对我太粗暴了吗？

lines.en: : Worse. You started crying.
lines.zh: : 更糟。你哭了。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, I’ve gotten more used to banging idols since then, so maybe that won’t happen anymore?
lines.zh: : 嗯，从那以后我干偶像干得比较习惯了，所以也许不会再那样了？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat31
: Again. I am {i}right{/i} here. And {i}still{/i} very much upset over the fact that your childhood friend is now sleeping in the same bed as you, thank you very much.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍。我{i}就{/i}在这儿。而且我现在{i}还很{/i}在意你那位青梅竹马如今睡在同一张床上这件事，非常感谢。

lines.en: : So is it {i}her{/i} you hate more? Or Noriko?
lines.zh: : 那你更恨的是{i}她{/i}？还是 Noriko？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat32
: How is that relevant?! Aren’t you supposed to be teaching me about “old” Maya?!
lines.zh: : 这有什么关系？！你不是应该给我讲讲"旧"Maya 吗？！

lines.en: : Old Maya hated both of them too and it was always sort of a touchy subject.
lines.zh: : 旧 Maya 也恨她们两个，而且这一直是个有点敏感的话题。

lines.en: : It’s a touchy subject {i}now{/i} too! So why do {i}I{/i} have to be the one to do it?!
lines.zh: : {i}现在{/i}也是敏感话题！那为什么非得由{i}我{/i}来开口？！

lines.en: : Because I can no longer be gaslit into thinking that information may cause both the universe and {i}me{/i} to explode.
lines.zh: : 因为我再也不会被忽悠着相信"这些信息可能会让宇宙和{i}我{/i}一起爆炸"了。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat33
: Fine. You caught me. It is I — Maya prime. I never disappeared at all. I just faked it for attention. Guess we have to have sex now. Oh well.
lines.zh: : 行吧。你抓到我了。就是我——Maya 本尊。我根本没消失过。我只是为了博关注装的。看来现在我们得做爱了。唉，没办法。

lines.en: : Wake me up when it’s over. I’ll be thinking about time and stuff.
lines.zh: : 完事儿了叫我。我要去想时间和那些东西了。

lines.en: : Close, but you’re not there yet.
lines.zh: : 很接近了，但还没到。

lines.en: : Fuck.
: You really won’t talk about it?
lines.zh: : 你真的不肯谈这个？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat34
: Sensei — I’m {i}bad{/i} at talking. I don’t know how else to get that through to you. Like, fuck- all this banter alone is enough to make my head hurt.
lines.zh: : Sensei——我{i}不擅长{/i}说话。我不知道还能怎么让你明白。操，光是这些斗嘴就够让我头疼了。

lines.en: : Then why-
lines.zh: : 那为什么——

lines.en: : I said it earlier. Because I {i}miss{/i} you.
lines.zh: : 我刚才说过了。因为我{i}想{/i}你。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat35
: When I sit down and try to remember literally {i}anything{/i} about {i}any{/i} part of my life — {i}you’re{/i} there. You have {i}always{/i} been there.
lines.zh: : 每当我坐下来，努力回想我人生里{i}任何一部分{/i}的{i}任何一件事{/i}——{i}你{/i}都在那儿。你{i}一直{/i}都在那儿。

lines.en: : So going this long without you and having to learn how to function as an actual independent person has been fucking {i}bullshit.{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以这么长时间没有你，还得学着当一个真正独立的人，真是他妈的{i}一坨狗屎{/i}。

lines.en: : {size=-2}Which I’m sure you’ll give me shit about since you always talked about how {i}important{/i} that was during tutoring, but whatever. I’ve never really {i}wanted{/i} to be my own thing since meeting you in the first place.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}我猜你肯定会拿这个挤兑我，毕竟你辅导我的时候总说那有多{i}重要{/i}，但随便吧。自从遇见你，我就从来没真{i}想{/i}成为自己的什么。{/size}

lines.en: : So yeah, I’ll talk to you. I’ll talk your ear off because I’m just excited to be {i}near{/i} you again. I’m excited you’ll {i}listen.{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以没错，我会跟你说话。我会说到你耳朵起茧，因为我就是很高兴又能{i}待在{/i}你身边。我很高兴你愿意{i}听{/i}。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat36
: But that doesn’t mean it’s easy...even if it sounds like it is. Even if it {i}looks{/i} like it is. Because things aren’t always exactly as they seem.
lines.zh: : 但这不代表那很容易……哪怕听起来容易。哪怕{i}看起来{/i}容易。因为事情并不总是看起来那样。

lines.en: : You should know that much...right?
lines.zh: : 这一点你应该很清楚……对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...I know that much.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这一点我很清楚。

lines.en: : So can we...maybe wait on the whole Nakayama discussion? Until {i}after{/i} I’ve gotten less sour about how {i}she’s{/i} your number one now and I’m just...{i}there.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那我们能不能……先别聊 Nakayama 的事？{i}等我{/i}不再那么酸溜溜地想着{i}她{/i}现在是你的第一位、而我只是在……{i}那儿{/i}。

lines.en: : I never said she was my number one, Maya.
lines.zh: : 我从来没说过她是你的第一位，Maya。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat37
: She fucking sleeps in your bed, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 她他妈的睡在你的床上，Sensei……

lines.en: : She’s the first person to see you every single day. I’m lucky if I even {i}do.{/i}
lines.zh: : 她是每天第一个见到你的人。我{i}能见着你{/i}就算走运了。

lines.en: : Then I’ll see you more. Starting right now.
lines.zh: : 那我就多见你。从现在开始。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat38
: You...
: You {i}will?{/i}
: I will.
lines.zh: : 真的。

lines.en: : You’re not...just saying that to shut me up?
lines.zh: : 你不是……只是为了让我闭嘴才这么说的？

lines.en: : No...I’m not.
lines.zh: : 不是……我不是。

lines.en: : I’m ready to start...moving on. Or trying to. I can’t stay hung up on the memories of you when...
lines.zh: : 我已经准备好开始……往前走了。或者说试着往前走。我不能一直吊在对你的回忆里，当……

lines.en: : When...what?
lines.zh: : 当……什么？

lines.en: : When there’s a chance they might come back. That they’re...still in there somewhere. Like mine were.
lines.zh: : 当它们还有可能回来的时候。它们……还在某个地方。就像我那些回忆一样。

lines.en: : Just...mine were of...this same timeline. And yours would be of...probably millions.
lines.zh: : 只是……我那些是关于……同一条时间线的。而你的那些大概是关于……几百万条的。

lines.en: : That’s not the answer you wanted to hear, is it?
lines.zh: : 这不是你想听的答案，对吧？

lines.en: : I’d have liked something more normal there, I think. Now I just have to worry about what would happen to me if I suddenly had millions of years worth of memories.
lines.zh: : 我想我更希望听到正常一点的答案。现在我只得担心，如果我突然拥有了几百万年的记忆，我会变成什么样。

lines.en: : Memories {i}without{/i} you. Memories of {i}looking{/i} for you. When I just told you minutes ago that you’re {i}there{/i} for all of mine.
lines.zh: : {i}没有{/i}你的记忆。{i}寻找{/i}你的记忆。而我几分钟前才刚跟你说，我所有的记忆里都{i}有你{/i}。

lines.en: : You want me to lose that?...
lines.zh: : 你希望我失去那些吗？……

lines.en: : I...well...
: Can you just tell me you love me instead?
lines.zh: : 你能不能干脆说你爱我？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat39
: Or...something {i}close{/i} at least.
lines.zh: : 或者……至少说点{i}接近{/i}的。

lines.en: : Natsume Sōseki.
lines.zh: : Natsume Sōseki。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat40
: ...I’m sorry?
: You know that one line, right? The one people are always using to say a thing {i}without{/i} saying a thing.
lines.zh: : 你知道那句台词吧？人们总是借它来说一件事，却又{i}没真的说出口{/i}的那句。

lines.en: : I do...
lines.zh: : 我知道……

lines.en: : You’re not...going to say {i}that{/i} thing, though?
lines.zh: : 你不会……是要说{i}那{/i}句话吧？

lines.en: : Nope. Everybody says {i}that{/i} thing now. So I’m just going to say the author’s name and you’re going to have to deal with it.
lines.zh: : 不。现在人人都说{i}那句话{/i}了。所以我就只说作者的名字，你自己看着办吧。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat41
: Heh...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……

lines.en: : I’ll take it...
lines.zh: : 我收下了……

lines.en: : I hope you know I’m...gonna hold you to that whole “seeing me more” thing too. Like...don’t be surprised if I’m just...there when you wake up one day.
lines.zh: : 我希望你知道，那个"多见我"的事我也会跟你算账的。比如……哪天你醒来发现我就在那儿，别太惊讶。

lines.en: : Next to Niki?
lines.zh: : 在 Niki 旁边？

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat42
: Yeah. I can show her how it’s done. Then she’ll feel so bad about her own abilities that she’ll be forced to move out and {i}I{/i} can move in instead.
lines.zh: : 对啊。{i}我{/i}可以让她见识见识什么叫专业。然后她会对自己的能力惭愧到被迫搬走，我就可以搬进来了。

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m sure Ami would {i}love{/i} that.
lines.zh: : 是啊。Ami 肯定{i}喜欢{/i}。

lines.en: : Fuck Ami.
lines.zh: : 去他妈的 Ami。

lines.en: : I’m sure Ami would love {i}that{/i} too.
lines.zh: : 我肯定 Ami 也会喜欢{i}这句{/i}的。

lines.en: scene mayaboxwaitwhat43
: Heheh...probably {i}too{/i} much.
lines.zh: : 呵呵……大概喜欢得{i}过头{/i}了。

lines.en: We stand there...just staring at each other for a while. Wanting more, but taking nothing.
lines.zh: 我们站在那儿……就这么盯着对方看了好一会儿。想要更多，却什么也不拿。

lines.en: It feels kind of strange — the way we’re watched by the moon. And how it dissuades me from grabbing her wrist and pulling her back to my home right now.
lines.zh: 感觉有点奇怪——月亮就这么看着我们。而它劝住了我，没有现在就抓住她的手腕、把她拽回我家。

lines.en: I think...
lines.zh: 我想……

lines.en: I think there’s somewhere else I want to take her instead, though.
lines.zh: 我想，我更想带她去的是别的地方。

lines.en: : Maya.
lines.zh: : Maya。

lines.en: : Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei。

lines.en: : Are you hungry?
lines.zh: : 你饿了吗？

lines.en: scene black
: Always.
lines.zh: : 一直都饿。
